rationale: The PLP likely failed due to a blocking cookie/geo modal and a locale path that includes a redundant or incompatible segment (/en-gb/en-int/). Moncler commonly renders PLP items in a client-side grid; without accepting cookies or closing the geo modal, tiles may not mount. We add safe, non-destructive pre-clicks for OneTrust and a generic close, expand wait_for selectors to include the PLP grid/tile patterns, and enable incremental scrolling to trigger lazy loading. URL normalization removes the second locale segment and locks to /en-gb/, reducing redirect loops and empty locale traps. Selectors target common Moncler/SFCC patterns while remaining broad enough to survive minor class/name changes.
